outcome: Abnormal progression or cessation of dilatation
cohort: 60 pregnant women at 37 to 42 weeks gestation.
finding: Estimated fetal weight and head circumference were directly and significantly correlated with cesarean section and abnormal progression or cessation of dilatation.
